prospective_hash_recipe: sha256 over the text of `sha256sum` output for every file in the sealed directory (cases.jsonl, families.json, gold.jsonl), one '<hex>  <name>' line per file with names relative to that directory, sorted as `LC_ALL=C sort` sorts them (byte order), each line ending in LF. Equivalent, run from the sealed directory: ls | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum
tree_hash_recipe: sha256 over the text of `sha256sum` output for every file under the benchmark root except SHA256SUMS and freeze_receipt.json, one '<hex>  <path>' line per file with paths relative to the root (no leading ./), sorted as `LC_ALL=C sort` sorts them (byte order), each line ending in LF. Equivalent, run from the benchmark root: find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS ! -name freeze_receipt.json | sed 's|^./||' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum
